description: Core trip UI: responsive app shell with segmented navigation (mobile bottom tabs + desktop sidebar), warm Tailwind theme + reusable UI primitives, the 'plan at a glance' Dashboard home with countdown + trip-progress, the editable day-by-day itinerary for all 5 days with legs/timings/mileage/per-stop notes and the editable places/stops library, and the car-rental/one-way drop-off panel. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Create the app shell: src/app/(app)/layout.tsx with a mobile-first bottom tab bar and a desktop sidebar (segments: Dashboard, Itinerary, Map, Group, Money, Logistics, Moments) plus a header with trip title and an editor-unlock control wired to useEditor(). Move the real home into the (app) group.

Define warm theme tokens in src/app/globals.css (Tailwind v4 @theme / CSS variables: warm palette, typography scale) and build src/components/ui/* primitives: Card, Button, Badge, Stat, SectionHeader, EmptyState, EditableField (inline-edit gated by canEdit). Build src/components/nav/* (BottomTabs, Sidebar, EditorUnlock dialog).

Build the Dashboard (src/app/(app)/page.tsx + src/components/dashboard/*): trip summary stats (5 nights, 4 bases, ~1,282 mi, ~21.4 hr, pace note), the route ledger (each night + leg), and src/components/countdown/* live countdown to Dec 27 + a trip-progress indicator. Warm, personal tone (not a dry dashboard).

Build the itinerary: src/app/(app)/itinerary/page.tsx (overview of 5 days) and src/app/(app)/itinerary/[day]/page.tsx (per-day: legs with drive-times + 5:30am starts, mileage, per-stop notes). src/components/itinerary/* and src/components/places/* for the editable per-day places/stops library (add/remove via repository, gated by canEdit; in mock mode mutates mock-store).

Build the car-rental / one-way drop-off panel: src/components/rental/* rendered within Logistics or at src/app/(app)/logistics/rental/page.tsx — editable manual fields (company, pickup/drop, dates, base rate, one-way drop fee, notes) persisted via repository with mock fallback.
Commit locally: `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: app shell, dashboard, itinerary, places, rental panel"`.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run dev` serves / and every segment route resolves; nav renders as bottom tabs on narrow viewport and sidebar on wide viewport.
Dashboard shows all seed summary stats and a live countdown to Dec 27.
All 5 itinerary days render with the exact seed mileage and drive-times; adding a stop in mock mode (after editor unlock) appears in the day's list.
Rental panel renders and fields are editable in mock mode.
`npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run build` all pass with no .env.local.
verification: cd d:\Personal-Projects\trip-site; npm run lint; npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build
npm run dev; load http://localhost:3000 and each segment; resize to confirm responsive nav; unlock editor and add a stop
findings:
APP SHELL: src/app/(app)/layout.tsx is the segmented shell (Sidebar + BottomTabs + AppHeader). The real home moved from src/app/page.tsx (deleted) to src/app/(app)/page.tsx. Every segment lives under the (app) group. Root src/app/layout.tsx unchanged.

NAV: src/components/nav/segments.ts exports SEGMENTS (Segment[] with href/label/icon). Routes: '/' Dashboard, '/itinerary', '/map', '/group', '/money', '/logistics', '/moments'. Add new segments there. NavIcon renders a single SVG path on a 0 0 24 24 viewBox. AppHeader embeds EditorUnlock which wires useEditor() (unlock dialog). Sidebar is md:flex (desktop), BottomTabs is md:hidden (mobile); active state via usePathname + startsWith.

UI PRIMITIVES (src/components/ui/): Card, Button (variants primary|ghost|outline, sizes sm|md), Badge (tones neutral|ember|sand|success), Stat (label/value/hint for dashboard dl grids), SectionHeader (title/subtitle/action), EmptyState (title/description/action), EditableField (inline edit gated by `canEdit`; props value/canEdit/onSave/multiline/placeholder/displayClassName; uses adjust-state-during-render pattern, NOT a setState-in-effect, to satisfy react-hooks/set-state-in-effect lint rule).

THEME: src/app/globals.css defines warm palette as CSS vars + @theme (Tailwind v4): sand-50/100/200/300, ember-400/500/600, clay-700, ink-800/900, plus --color-surface, --color-muted, border via var(--border) (use `border-[color:var(--border)]`). Typography scale text-xs..text-4xl overridden. Utility classes available: bg-sand-100, text-ember-600, text-ink-900, text-muted, bg-surface, etc.

DASHBOARD: src/app/(app)/page.tsx composes TripSummary + RouteLedger + Countdown + TripProgress. src/components/dashboard/TripSummary.tsx (6 Stats from seed: nights, travelers, intercity ~1,282 mi, driving ~21.4 hr, 4 bases, Fast pace). RouteLedger lists nights (days with overnight) linking to /itinerary/[dayNumber]. src/components/countdown/Countdown.tsx (live to startDate 2025-12-27, days/hrs/min/sec; SSR-safe null placeholder; initial setNow via setTimeout(,0) inside effect to pass lint) and TripProgress.tsx (progress bar across trip window).

ITINERARY: src/app/(app)/itinerary/page.tsx (overview, 6 days incl checkout) uses src/components/itinerary/DayCard.tsx. Per-day src/app/(app)/itinerary/[day]/page.tsx matches by dayNumber (string) against seed; params is a Promise (await it); generateStaticParams enumerates dayNumbers 1..6. LegList renders RouteLeg miles/driveTime/departTime. Notes section renders day.notes.

PLACES/STOPS LIBRARY (src/components/places/): StopsLibrary.tsx is the editable per-day stops list. IMPORTANT DECISION: Stop has no dayId and the mock store keys stops flat, so add/remove persist by UPSERTING THE WHOLE Day RECORD via repository.upsert('days', nextDay) with a mutated stops array. This works in mock mode (acceptance gate runs in mock mode). It also writes legs/notes/stops back to the days table, but the Supabase `stops` table is separate with a day_id FK and is NOT updated by this path — a later feature wiring real Supabase stop CRUD should either (a) switch StopsLibrary to the stops entity with a dayId added to the Stop type + stops table, or (b) accept day-record-as-container. AddStopForm builds a Stop with id `stop-${dayId}-${Date.now()}`. StopRow has editor-only Remove.

RENTAL: Added a NEW entity `rentals` -> table `rental_agreements`. New type RentalAgreement in src/lib/types.ts (company, pickupLocation, dropoffLocation, pickupDate, dropoffDate, baseRate|null, oneWayDropFee|null, notes?). Registered in src/lib/data/entities.ts (EntityMap, ENTITY_NAMES, TABLE_NAMES) and hydrated in mock-store.ts from new seed export `rentals` in trip-seed.ts (single draft 'rental-one-way', Tempe->SF, nothing priced). SQL: added public.rental_agreements table + RLS + realtime in supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql and a seed row in supabase/seed.sql. UI: src/components/rental/RentalPanel.tsx (inline-editable fields via EditableField, money parse strips non-numeric, persists via repository.upsert('rentals',...)). Rendered at both src/app/(app)/logistics/page.tsx and src/app/(app)/logistics/rental/page.tsx.

PLACEHOLDER SEGMENTS (owned by later FEATs, currently EmptyState pages so nav resolves): /map (FEAT map), /group, /money, /moments. Moments is currently INSIDE the (app) group; the planned public /moments page (per context directory_structure) is not yet built — reconcile when building Moments/gallery.

SHARED HOOK: src/hooks/use-entity-list.ts (useEntityList(entity, seed) -> {items, loading, refresh}; lists via repository + subscribe). Not yet consumed by FEAT-003 UI but available for Group/Money/etc.

VERIFICATION (mock mode, no .env.local): npm run lint clean; npm run build succeeds (Next 16 Turbopack, 22 routes); npx tsc --noEmit clean. NOTE: run `npm run build` (or clean .next) BEFORE `npx tsc --noEmit` — stale .next/types/validator.ts referencing the deleted src/app/page.tsx otherwise makes tsc fail; a fresh build regenerates the validator for the (app) group.
